Trifolium Repens.

Trifolium repens. White Clover. N. O. Leguminosæ. Trituration or tincture of flower heads.

Clinical.─Mumps. Salivation.

Characteristics.─The proving of Tr. r. produced a specific action on the salivary glands. Hale says it produces marked salivation in horses.

Relations.─Compare: jabor., Pilo.

SYMPTOMS.

6. Face.─Feeling of fulness or congestion of all the salivary glands.─Discomfort and even pain in glands followed by copious flow of saliva.─One prover felt just as if she had mumps coming on.
